'''Anahul Sato''' was the gruff dockmaster of the [[Exploracorp's private spaceport]]. He taught [[Bey]] how to use a [[Hydrospanner/Legends|hydrospanner]]. Before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] ended in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] he had a place in the [[Far Suns]] rank and flew to many worlds beyond the rim.<ref name="TEGTW Author's cut 12">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-12-tales-of-the-new-republic|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 12: Tales of the New Republic}}</ref>
